title: Diátaxis
summary: Diátaxis is a documentation framework developed by Daniele Procida that provides a systematic approach to organizing technical documentation into four distinct types: tutorials (learning-oriented), how-to guides (task-oriented), reference (information-oriented), and explanation (understanding-oriented). It addresses the common problem of disorganized and confusing documentation by establishing clear purposes for each type of documentation.
problem_solved: Solves the problem of unstructured and confusing technical documentation by providing a clear framework that aligns documentation types with user needs.
why_valuable: It dramatically improves developer experience and documentation quality by helping technical writers and developers create documentation that users can actually find and use effectively.
